caption: Eating a Costco hot dog right now:
title: Eating a Costco hot dog right now 🌭

through_line.name: the food court tray
through_line.prop_prompt: a shallow red plastic tray holding one long hot dog in a bun and an oversized waxed paper soda cup with a straw, the cup sweating
progression: a long shape and a huge cup descending together
the cup overflowing as it comes, liquid running ahead of it
the hot dog lands upright and greets the room
the cavity is half liquid, the tray floating on top
a second hot dog appears above
the tray drifts, empty, in a full cavity

blocks.through_line_state: a long shape and a huge cup descending together
blocks.sfx: a soda fountain hiss, a paper crinkle, a swallow
shots: MEDIUM, eye level: Pipes looking up at two shapes coming down together
CLOSE, low angle: Gut's brows lifting slowly
MEDIUM, high angle: an enormous waxed cup sliding down beside a long shape
CLOSE on the eyes: Gut doing the math and not liking it

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: Delivery. It's warm.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Warm from where exactly, Pipes?

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: The food court. It's a hot dog.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: The dollar-fifty one? With the soda?

blocks.through_line_state: the cup overflowing as it comes, liquid running ahead of it
blocks.sfx: a rushing pour, a paper squeak, a groan
shots: CLOSE, low angle: Gut shouting upward, jaw set
MEDIUM, eye level: liquid sheeting past Pipes ahead of the cup
MEDIUM, high angle: the tube walls glossy and running wet
CLOSE on Pipes' eyes counting the refills

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: One hot dog. That's it. Nothing else.

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: She refilled the cup. Twice.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: That cup holds thirty-two ounces.

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: Then she got a churro. Sorry.

blocks.through_line_state: the hot dog lands upright and opens its eyes
blocks.sfx: a soft landing splash, a rising glug, a friendly honk
shots: MEDIUM, high angle: the hot dog landing upright in rising liquid
CLOSE, low angle: two friendly eyes opening along the bun
MEDIUM, eye level: Gut treading in liquid that keeps rising
CLOSE on the eyes: the hot dog cheerful, the water line climbing

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Sir. You're standing in my liquid.

turns.speaker: hotdog
turns.line: Buddy! Great value, right? Dollar fifty!

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: That's not the issue here.

turns.speaker: hotdog
turns.line: Soda's unlimited too! I told her!

blocks.through_line_state: the cavity is half liquid, the tray floating on top
blocks.sfx: a monitor blip, a distant queue murmur, a sigh
shots: MEDIUM, eye level: HQ watching the monitor without expression
CLOSE, low angle: on the screen, a hand joining a queue again
MEDIUM, high angle: HQ shrugging with both tiny arms
CLOSE on HQ's eyes, entirely at peace with this

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: HQ. She's going back to the counter.

turns.speaker: hq
turns.line: For what? She already ate.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: For another one. A second hot dog.

turns.speaker: hq
turns.line: It's a dollar fifty. I understand her.

blocks.through_line_state: a second hot dog appears above
blocks.sfx: a frantic drip, a rising whine, a squeak
shots: CLOSE, low angle: Buzz shaking hard, sweat drop already flying
MEDIUM, eye level: Buzz bouncing, Gut refusing to look
MEDIUM, high angle: Buzz visibly rounder than the last shot
CLOSE on the eyes: Buzz staring into the camera, betrayed

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Buzz, how are we doing up there?

turns.speaker: buzz
turns.line: We're at capacity. We passed capacity.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: You always say that, Buzz.

turns.speaker: buzz
turns.line: Thirty-two ounces. Times three refills.

blocks.through_line_state: the tray drifts, empty, in a full cavity
blocks.sfx: one low rumble, a distant car door, silence
shots: MEDIUM, eye level: the tunnel, quiet and amber
CLOSE, low angle: Gut relaxing for the first time all episode
MEDIUM, high angle: Rusty's eyes opening behind him
CLOSE on the eyes: Gut's relief evaporating

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: We made it out. Nothing even happened.

turns.speaker: rusty
turns.line: The parking lot is very far away.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Rusty. How far is far?

turns.speaker: rusty
turns.line: Farther than you think.
